summary.short: Bill amending the Energy Efficiency Act (EnEfG), Energy Services Act (EDL-G) and procurement regulations VgV, SektVO, KonzVgV to implement EU Directive 2023/1791. Sets efficiency duties for public bodies, energy audits, management systems, data-centre efficiency and waste-heat rules, and procurement criteria; in force the day after promulgation.
summary.long: The Federal Government's bill (Drucksache 21/8027, dated 16 September 2026) amends the Energy Efficiency Act (EnEfG), the Energy Services Act (EDL-G), the Vergabeverordnung (VgV), the Sektorenverordnung (SektVO) and the Konzessionsvergabeverordnung (KonzVgV) to complete the transposition of EU Energy Efficiency Directive 2023/1791. For public institutions, it sets an annual 1.9% final-energy saving target from a 2021 base (§ 6), energy or environmental management system duties, and annual consumption reporting to a federal energy register (§ 6a). For firms, it requires cost-benefit assessment of energy-efficiency solutions for planning or investment decisions above EUR 100 million (§ 5), energy audits for enterprises above 23.6 GWh of annual consumption (§ 8), and implementation plans for those between 2.77 and 23.6 GWh (§ 9). Data-centre operators face power usage effectiveness limits of 1.6 from 1 July 2027 and 1.4 from 1 July 2030 for facilities commissioned before 1 July 2026, reuse-energy shares, a renewable electricity share rising to 100% from 2030, and waste-heat cost-benefit analyses (§§ 11, 16). Procurement rules require energy-efficiency classes and reference values in tenders and concessions (VgV § 67, SektVO § 58, KonzVgV § 33a). The BAFA conducts random checks, and violations may be fined up to EUR 100,000 or EUR 50,000 (§§ 18, 19). The Act enters into force the day after promulgation (Art. 6).

notes: Part 1 contains the full operative text (Art. 1 to 6, EU-Rechtsakte list) and the Begründung, so relations come from both. Amendment rows cite the amending articles only; the amended acts (EnEfG, EDL-G, VgV, SektVO, KonzVgV) are not consolidated here. Internal inconsistencies: (a) § 20(2) EnEfG sets the first transmission of data-centre information for 15 May 2024, a past date in a 2026 bill; (b) § 6a(2) and (3) EnEfG set 2025 as the first data year, while § 20(1) sets the first transmission in 2026 (not explained in the text); (c) Art. 2 Nr. 8 Buchst. i cites 'Richtlinie (EU) 1275/2024' without the year 2024 (apparently a typo for 2024/1275); (d) Begründung E.3 contains garbled wording ('um und 14,2 Millionen. Euro'); (e) several dates are placeholders ('[einsetzen: Datum ...]') tied to the entry-into-force date in Art. 6. Registry IDs for the cited instruments were not supplied, so target_instrument_id is left empty. Part 2 contains only explanatory material (Zu-Artikel comments in the Begründung), the NKR statement (Anlage 2), the Bundesrat opinion (Anlage 3) and the Government counter-statement (Anlage 4). No operative provisions are coded here; relations are taken from these texts and the enacted wording in part 1 was not checked. target_instrument_id is left empty because registry IDs for the target acts were not verified. Inconsistencies in the text: Regulation (EU) 2023/955 is called Richtlinie in the Anlage 1 comment and Verordnung in the EED citation; the Gegenäußerung to item 4 cites Richtlinie (EU) 1793/2023, apparently meaning 2023/1791; the Begründung on Article 2 Nummer 1 Buchstabe b cites Richtlinie (EU) 2023/1971 for September 2023, apparently meaning the EED. The § 8 Absatz 2 EDL-G comment contains an unfilled placeholder for the entry-into-force date. The Government rejects most Bundesrat proposals (Anlage 4), so the Bundesrat wording is not in the bill unless the Government accepted it.

thresholds.measurement: Average annual total final energy consumption over the last three completed calendar years; measurement method not stated in this part
thresholds.consequence: Companies above the threshold fall within the scope of the energy audit obligation (EDL-G § 1 Nr. 4) as described in the explanatory memorandum.
thresholds.conditions: Companies that are obliged under § 8 Abs. 1 of the Gesetz zur Steigerung der Energieeffizienz to have an energy or environmental management system are excluded.

evidence.provision: Begründung zu Art. 2 Nr. 1 Buchst. b (§ 1 Nr. 4 EDL-G)
evidence.quote: auf Unternehmen mit einem jährlichen durchschnittlichen Gesamtendenergieverbrauch innerhalb der letzten drei abgeschlossenen Kalenderjahre von mehr als 2,77 Gigawattstunden geändert

thresholds.variable_text: Gesamtendenergieverbrauch der Unternehmen (Schwellenwert für Energie- oder Umweltmanagementsysteme)
thresholds.measurement: Total energy consumption of the company; window and measurement method not stated in this part
thresholds.consequence: Companies above the threshold are obliged to introduce an energy and environmental management system (as described in the Bundesrat statement on the bill's § 8 Abs. 1 EnEfG-E).
thresholds.conditions: The Bundesrat statement describes the bill's text; the Federal Government agreed to adjust the formulation for companies consuming exactly 23.6 GWh.

evidence.provision: Anlage 3, Stellungnahme des Bundesrates Nr. 25 (Begründung, zu Art. 1 Nr. 7 (§ 9 Abs. 1 EnEfG))
evidence.quote: In § 8 Absatz 1 EnEfG-E sind Unternehmen mit einem Gesamtendenergieverbrauch von mehr als 23,6 Gigawattstunden (GWh) verpflichtet, ein Energie- und Umweltmanagement einzuführen.

thresholds.variable_text: Gesamtendenergieverbrauch der Unternehmen (Schwelle für Umsetzungspläne nach § 9 EnEfG)
thresholds.value_text: ab dem Schwellenwert von 2,77 GWh bis zu diesem Schwellenwert von 23,6 GWh
thresholds.measurement: Total energy consumption of the company; window and measurement method not stated in this part
thresholds.consequence: Companies in the range must prepare implementation plans for the energy saving measures identified as economic in the energy audit (per the Bundesrat reading of the bill's § 9 EnEfG-E).
thresholds.conditions: Range as described in the Bundesrat's explanatory statement of the bill's intent; the Bundesrat proposed the upper limit wording 'höchstens 23,6' in its own proposal text, which the Federal Government only partly accepted.

evidence.provision: Anlage 3, Stellungnahme des Bundesrates Nr. 25 (Begründung, zu Art. 1 Nr. 7 (§ 9 Abs. 1 EnEfG))
evidence.quote: Der § 9 EnEfG-E soll alle Unternehmen ab dem Schwellenwert von 2,77 GWh bis zu diesem Schwellenwert von 23,6 GWh verpflichten.

thresholds.measurement: Total usable floor area (Gesamtnutzfläche) of the non-residential building being renovated
thresholds.consequence: The public authority must examine whether energy performance contracts and other performance-based energy services are feasible when renovating the building.
thresholds.conditions: Applies to renovations of non-residential buildings; implements Art. 29 paras. 4 and 5 of Directive (EU) 2023/1791 as described in the explanatory memorandum.

evidence.provision: Begründung zu Art. 2 Nr. 2 (§ 3 Abs. 2 Satz 4 EDL-G)
evidence.quote: Bei Renovierungen von Nichtwohngebäuden mit einer Gesamtnutzfläche von mehr als 750 m2 hat die öffentliche Hand zu prüfen

thresholds.variable_text: Einwohnerzahl der Gebietskörperschaft (Ausnahme für öffentliche Einrichtungen)
thresholds.measurement: Population of the Gebietskörperschaft; measurement source not stated
thresholds.consequence: Public facilities in municipalities within this population range are exempt under the transitional provision, which applies only until 31 December 2026 (per the Bundesrat statement).
thresholds.conditions: The exemption applies only until the end of 31 December 2026, as stated in the Bundesrat statement.

evidence.provision: Anlage 3, Stellungnahme des Bundesrates Nr. 19 Buchst. c (Begründung, zu Art. 1 Nr. 17 (§ 20 EnEfG))
evidence.quote: Die Ausnahmen für öffentliche Einrichtungen in Gebietskörperschaften mit mehr als 5 000 und maximal 50 000 Einwohnern können gestrichen werden, da diese nur bis zum Ablauf des 31. Dezember 2026 gelten.
